create.name: Ananda Sangha Pune
create.bio:
Ananda Sangha Pune shares the Kriya Yoga path of Paramhansa Yogananda as passed on by his disciple Swami Kriyananda, founder of the worldwide Ananda movement. Pune is something of a hub for Ananda in India: the site describes the Ananda Yoga School of India as headquartered in the city, and Ananda's meditation retreat lies just outside it.

The city centre occupies an office suite on the first floor of the Centriole Building on ITI Road in Aundh, fitted out as a carpeted meditation hall with a shrine to the line of Kriya gurus. Ananda Yoga classes run there in person from Tuesday to Friday mornings; the style links each posture with a silent affirmation and includes breathing practice, meditation and yoga philosophy, aiming to lift awareness rather than simply exercise the body.

Meditation is taught through a graded Kriya Yoga course. The first level, a two-part class series in English or Marathi, introduces the Hong-Sau concentration technique and Yogananda's Energization Exercises with the Lessons in Meditation textbook and WhatsApp support between classes. The second level works through Kriyananda's Art and Science of Raja Yoga. The centre also holds satsangs, guided meditations, book study, kirtan and concerts, children's classes and corporate workshops.

courses.title: Ananda Yoga classes (Aundh)
courses.description: In-person hatha yoga classes at the Aundh centre, Tuesday to Friday 8:30–9:30 am, in the Ananda Yoga style: postures paired with silent affirmations, with an emphasis on inner awareness and energy rather than workout. Discounts available on enquiry.

courses.title: Learn to Meditate: Path of Kriya Yoga (Level 1)
courses.description: A two-part class series at the Aundh centre teaching the Hong-Sau technique and the basics of a daily meditation routine, with the Lessons in Meditation course book and WhatsApp support between classes. Taught in English (Marathi classes on request); new dates are posted on the page.

courses.title: Kriya Yoga Meditation – Level 2 (The Art and Science of Raja Yoga)
courses.description: The second step towards Kriya initiation, based on Kriyananda's book: breath and the spinal currents, the chakras, will and devotion, yoga philosophy and psychology, energisation, postures and affirmations. Follows Level 1.
